from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct
from build_transfer import Asm,ROOT,HOOK,HOOK_PC,BASE,SOURCE_SHA
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prior=ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-pair-rollback-2026-10-18'
evidence=ROOT/'docs/condensed/validation/bluescsi-permanent-assignment-2026-10-18.json'
def records(x):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  if 'sample0' in x and 'sample1' in x:yield x
  for v in x.values():yield from records(v)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for v in x:yield from records(v)
source=next(records(json.loads(evidence.read_text())))
template=bytearray(bytes.fromhex(source['sample0'])+bytes.fromhex(source['sample1']))
assert len(template)==96
for ch in range(2):
 d=template[ch*48:(ch+1)*48]
 assert d[14:16]==bytes([127,ord('LR'[ch])])
 assert struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,40)==(ch*13,13)
 template[ch*48:ch*48+14]=b'BS1:PairTest  '
original=(ROOT/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
assert len(original)==1474560 and hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==SOURCE_SHA
assert original[0x853e:0xa480]==bytes(8002)
assert original[HOOK:HOOK+8]==bytes.fromhex('a171011ca15e9b1e')
a=Asm();saved=list(range(0x1c,0x60,2))+[0xda]
a.emit(0xf4,0xcb,1,0x0a,1,0xcb,1,0x0c,1)
for r in saved:a.emit(0xc8,r)
a.byte(0x14,0);a.imm(0x1c,15);a.st(0x1c,0x10a)
for offset,dest in [(70,0x5fa0),(72,0x5fa2),(74,0x5fa4),(76,0x5fa6)]:
 a.emit(0xa3,0x19);a.word(offset);a.emit(0x44);a.st(0x44,dest)
# Admit only when native receive and sender are idle.
a.ldb(0x44,0x2bba);a.cmpb(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
a.imm(0x1c,0x2be);a.st(0x1c,0x10c)
a.ldb(0x44,0xb1ae);a.cmpb(0x44,255);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
# Both public slots must be empty before allocation or staging changes.
a.imm(0x1c,0x34a);a.st(0x1c,0x10c)
for address in (0x8270,0x82a0):
 a.ldb(0x44,address);a.cmpb(0x44,127);a.cond(0xd7,'occupied')
a.ld(0x38,0x3616);a.cmp(0x38,13);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
a.imm(0x1c,0x299);a.st(0x1c,0x10c)
a.ld(0x3a,0x8f9e);a.ld(0x3c,0x8fa0)
# Failed claim must not latch the owner; retry succeeds while still masked.
a.imm(0x20,65535);a.call('claim');a.cmp(0x3e,1);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
a.ld(0x44,0x5ff0);a.cmp(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
a.ld(0x44,0x3616);a.cmp(0x44,13);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
a.imm(0x20,26);a.call('claim');a.cmp(0x3e,0);a.cond(0xd7,'failed')
# Copy a recorded, qualified pair into private 96-byte staging.
a.imm(0x48,0x5e10);a.imm(0x4a,0x5f00);a.imm(0x4c,48);a.call('copy')
# Rebase all five fixed-point addresses and allocation indices by 13 blocks.
for ch in range(2):
 for offset in (16,20,24,28,32):
  addr=0x5f00+ch*48+offset
  a.ld(0x44,addr);a.ld(0x46,addr+2)
  a.emit(0x65,0,0,0x44,0xa5,0xea,0,0x46)
  a.st(0x44,addr);a.st(0x46,addr+2)
 a.ld(0x44,0x5f28+ch*48);a.emit(0x65,13,0,0x44);a.st(0x44,0x5f28+ch*48)
a.imm(0x44,1);a.st(0x44,0x5e00);a.call('hold')
# Generate distinct channel data and fill the whole 13-block channel extents.
for ch in range(2):
 a.imm(0x4c,0x1200+ch*0x3000);a.call('fill_pattern')
 dest=8+(13+ch*13)*4608
 a.imm(0x2c,dest&65535);a.imm(0x34,dest>>16);a.imm(0x36,29)
 a.label('channel_'+str(ch));a.imm(0x28,0x4940);a.imm(0x2a,4096);a.call('dma')
 a.cmp(0x3e,0);a.cond(0xd7,'dma_failed');a.call('service')
 a.emit(0x65,0,8,0x2c,0xa5,0,0,0x34,5,0x36);a.cond(0xd7,'channel_'+str(ch))
 a.imm(0x2a,1024);a.call('dma');a.cmp(0x3e,0);a.cond(0xd7,'dma_failed');a.call('service')
a.imm(0x44,2);a.st(0x44,0x5e00);a.call('hold')
a.label('publish');a.imm(0x1c,0x34a);a.st(0x1c,0x10c)
a.imm(0x48,0x5f00);a.imm(0x4a,0x8270);a.imm(0x4c,48);a.call('copy')
a.imm(0x44,3);a.st(0x44,0x5e00)
a.st(0,0x5ff0);a.imm(0x44,0xb502);a.st(0x44,0x5ef0);a.jmp('exit')
a.label('occupied');a.imm(0x44,4);a.st(0x44,0x5e00);a.imm(0x44,0xb503);a.st(0x44,0x5ef0);a.jmp('exit')
# A timeout does not prove DMA is quiescent: retain ownership/reservation.
a.label('dma_failed');a.imm(0x44,0xb5ff);a.st(0x44,0x5ef0);a.jmp('exit')
a.label('failed');a.imm(0x44,0xdead);a.st(0x44,0x5ef0)
a.label('exit')
for r in reversed(saved):a.emit(0xcc,r)
a.emit(0xcf,1,0x0c,1,0xcf,1,0x0a,1,0xf5,*original[HOOK:HOOK+8],0xf0)
a.label('copy');a.emit(0xa2,0x49,0x44,0xc2,0x4b,0x44,5,0x4c);a.cond(0xd7,'copy');a.emit(0xf0)
# Reuse unchanged reserve, fill, adapter and DMA definitions from checkpoint35.
old=(prior/'build.py').read_text()
exec(old[old.index("a.label('reserve')"):old.index('code=a.finish()')])

a.label('claim');a.call('reserve');a.cmp(0x3e,0);a.cond(0xd7,'claim_return')
a.imm(0x44,1);a.st(0x44,0x5ff0)
a.label('claim_return');a.emit(0xf0)
a.label('hold');a.imm(0x36,30000);a.label('hold_loop');a.call('service');a.emit(5,0x36);a.cond(0xd7,'hold_loop');a.emit(0xf0)
a.label('service');a.emit(0xcb,1,0x0c,1)
for r in saved:a.emit(0xc8,r)
a.ld(0x44,0x5fa6);a.ld(0x46,0x5fa4);a.ld(0x48,0x5fa0);a.ld(0x4a,0x5fa2)
a.st(0x48,0x10c);a.st(0x4a,0x10a)
a.emit(0x39,0x45,3);a.jmp('service_mask');a.emit(0xb0,0x44,8,0xb0,0x47,0x13)
a.label('service_enable');a.emit(0xfb,*([0xfd]*8))
a.label('service_mask');a.emit(0xfa);a.byte(8,0);a.byte(0x13,0)
a.imm(0x48,15);a.st(0x48,0x10a)
for r in reversed(saved):a.emit(0xcc,r)
a.emit(0xcf,1,0x0c,1);a.label('service_exit');a.emit(0xf0)
# Hook is LCALL gate / JC existing CANCEL at6D30. No public state is changed.
a.label('sds_gate');a.emit(0xcb,1,0x0a,1);a.imm(0x6a,15);a.st(0x6a,0x10a)
a.ldb(0x6a,0x5ff0);a.emit(0xcf,1,0x0a,1);a.cmpb(0x6a,0);a.cond(0xd7,'sds_busy')
a.ldb(0x6a,0xb048);a.emit(0xf8,0xf0)
a.label('sds_busy');a.emit(0xf9,0xf0)
code=a.finish();assert len(code)<0xc02
image=bytearray(original);image[0x853e:0x853e+len(code)]=code
image[0x4800+0x5a0e:0x4800+0x5a72]=b'\xa5\x5a'+template+b'\x5a\xa5'
image[0x4800+0x5afe:0x4800+0x5b62]=b'\xa5\x5a'+bytes(96)+b'\x5a\xa5'
image[HOOK:HOOK+8]=bytes([0xef])+struct.pack('<H',(BASE-HOOK_PC-3)&65535)+bytes([0xfd])*5
assert original[0xf0dd:0xf0e2]==bytes.fromhex('b30148b06a')
gate=bytes([0xef])+struct.pack('<H',(a.labels['sds_gate']-0x6cdd-3)&65535)+bytes([0xdb,0x6d30-0x6ce2])
image[0xf0dd:0xf0e2]=gate
with (P/'S760224.PAIR-OWNER-V2.IMG').open('xb') as f:f.write(image)
(P/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest(),code_bytes=len(code),template=template.hex(),template_evidence_sha256=hashlib.sha256(evidence.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),labels=a.labels,decoded=a.rows),indent=2)+'\n')
print('Built',len(code),'bytes')

"""Private, ordinary-callback guest SCSI experiment; not release firmware."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, struct
import pypcode

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE=0x013e
BUFFER=0x4800
TABLE=0x5804
RECORDS=0x5a00
RECORD_SIZE=32
CONTROL=0x5ff0
SOURCE_SHA='3827ed4c46fd48abbec3095266164853033141d7bd15afe8dda0050d00e073cd'
HOOK_PC=0x9040
HOOK=0x4800+(0x181<<10)+(HOOK_PC&0x3fff)
CASES=[{'name': 'read-4k', 'cdb': '28 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 4096, 'status': 0, 'expected': 'scratch-first'}, {'name': 'write-4k', 'cdb': '2a 00 00 00 00 08 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 4096, 'status': 0, 'direction': 1, 'seed': 4951}, {'name': 'readback-4k', 'cdb': '28 00 00 00 00 08 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 4096, 'status': 0, 'expected': 'written'}, {'name': 'partial-write', 'cdb': '2a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4095, 'code': 5, 'length': 4095, 'status': 255, 'direction': 1, 'seed': 9320}, {'name': 'read-after-partial', 'cdb': '28 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 4096, 'status': 0, 'expected': 'scratch-first'}, {'name': 'out-of-range-write', 'cdb': '2a 00 ff ff ff ff 00 00 08 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 0, 'status': 2, 'direction': 1}, {'name': 'range-sense', 'cdb': '03 00 00 00 12 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 18, 'status': 0, 'sense': [5, 33]}, {'name': 'protected-write', 'cdb': '2a 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 00', 'target': 1, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 0, 'status': 2, 'direction': 1}, {'name': 'protected-sense', 'cdb': '03 00 00 00 12 00', 'target': 1, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 18, 'status': 0, 'sense': [7, 39]}, {'name': 'read-protected-cd', 'cdb': '28 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 00', 'target': 1, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 4096, 'status': 0, 'expected': 'cd-first'}, {'name': 'invalid-start', 'cdb': '1b 00 00 00 03 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 0, 'status': 2}, {'name': 'invalid-field-sense', 'cdb': '03 00 00 00 12 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 18, 'status': 0, 'sense': [5, 36]}, {'name': 'unsupported', 'cdb': '3f a5 5a 12 34 56 78 9a bc de', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 0, 'status': 2}, {'name': 'unsupported-sense', 'cdb': '03 00 00 00 12 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 18, 'status': 0, 'sense': [5, 32]}, {'name': 'sense-cleared', 'cdb': '03 00 00 00 12 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 18, 'status': 0, 'sense': [0, 0]}, {'name': 'ready-after-errors', 'cdb': '00 00 00 00 00 00', 'target': 2, 'capacity': 4096, 'code': 0, 'length': 0, 'status': 0}]

class Asm:
 def __init__(self): self.code=bytearray();self.labels={};self.fixups=[];self.rows=[]
 @property
 def pc(self):return BASE+len(self.code)
 def label(self,n):assert n not in self.labels;self.labels[n]=self.pc
 def emit(self,*b):self.code.extend(b)
 def word(self,n):self.code.extend(struct.pack('<H',n&65535))
 def imm(self,r,n):self.emit(0xa1);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def byte(self,r,n):self.emit(0xb1,n&255,r)
 def ld(self,r,a):self.emit(0xa3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def ldb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xb3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def st(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def stb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc7,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def mov(self,r,s):self.emit(0xa0,s,r)
 def clr(self,r):self.emit(1,r)
 def cmp(self,r,n):self.emit(0x89);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def cmpb(self,r,n):self.emit(0x99,n&255,r)
 def jmp(self,label,op=0xe7):
  self.emit(op);self.fixups.append((len(self.code),label,self.pc+2));self.word(0)
 def call(self,label):self.jmp(label,0xef)
 def cond(self,op,label):
  # Inverse conditional skips a long jump, avoiding hidden short-branch limits.
  self.emit(op^8,3);self.jmp(label)
 def finish(self):
  for index,label,after in self.fixups:
   assert label in self.labels,label
   self.code[index:index+2]=struct.pack('<H',(self.labels[label]-after)&65535)
  ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
  ins=ctx.disassemble(bytes(self.code),base_address=BASE).instructions
  assert sum(i.length for i in ins)==len(self.code)
  starts={i.addr.offset for i in ins}
  assert all(v in starts for k,v in self.labels.items() if k!='code_end')
  for i in ins:
   if i.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH'):
    assert int(i.body,16) in starts,(i.mnem,i.body)
  self.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(self.code[i.addr.offset-BASE:i.addr.offset-BASE+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in ins]
  return bytes(self.code)

def build(output):
 original=(ROOT/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
 assert len(original)==0x168000 and hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==SOURCE_SHA
 assert original[0x853e:0xa480]==bytes(8002)
 assert original[HOOK:HOOK+8]==bytes.fromhex('a1 71 01 1c a1 5e 9b 1e')
 a=Asm();a.label('entry');a.emit(0xf4) # Save PSW, WSR and MASK1; interrupts masked.
 a.label('entry_bank_read');a.emit(0xcb,1,0x0a,1)
 # WSR is zero at this qualified callback. Save all registers this probe uses.
 saved=list(range(0x1c,0x60,2))+[0xda]
 for r in saved:a.emit(0xc8,r)
 a.byte(0x14,0);a.imm(0x1c,15);a.st(0x1c,0x10a)
 # Capture the native bank and PUSHA frame through the guest's own stack.
 for offset,dest in [(70,6),(72,10),(74,8)]:
  a.emit(0xa3,0x19);a.word(offset);a.emit(0x44);a.st(0x44,CONTROL+dest)
 a.ldb(0x44,0x115);a.stb(0x44,CONTROL+14)
 # Own the PIO controller: mask native SCSI/DMA completion while preserving
 # the other IC4 sources; timer ISR ORs 0x44, leaving this bit clear.
 a.emit(0x71,0xef,0x44);a.stb(0x44,0x115)
 a.st(0,CONTROL+16);a.st(0,CONTROL+18);a.st(0,CONTROL+20);a.st(0,CONTROL+22);a.st(0,CONTROL+24)
 a.imm(0x44,0xb501);a.st(0x44,CONTROL)
 a.imm(0x20,TABLE);a.imm(0x22,RECORDS);a.imm(0x24,len(CASES));a.clr(0x26)
 a.label('case_loop');a.st(0x26,CONTROL+2)
 # Clear only the current diagnostic record. This is extension-owned test RAM.
 a.mov(0x48,0x22);a.imm(0x4a,RECORD_SIZE//2)
 a.label('clear_record');a.emit(0xc2,0x49,0);a.emit(5,0x4a);a.cond(0xd7,'clear_record')
 # Case layout: mask, CDB length, hold-ACK, reserved, capacity, poll limit,
 # unused word, CDB bytes at+10 (padded to14), total record24.
 a.emit(0xb2,0x21,0x50,0xb2,0x21,0x52,0xb2,0x21,0x54,0xb2,0x21,0x5c)
 a.emit(0xa2,0x21,0x2e,0xa2,0x21,0x3a,0xa2,0x21,0x56)
 a.mov(0x28,0x20);a.mov(0x2a,0x52);a.emit(0x61,0xff,0,0x2a)
 a.imm(0x2c,BUFFER)
 a.imm(0x48,BUFFER);a.imm(0x4a,2048);a.mov(0x4c,0x56)
 a.label('fill_buffer');a.emit(0xc2,0x49,0x4c);a.emit(0x65,1,1,0x4c)
 a.mov(0x44,0x4a);a.emit(0x61,63,0,0x44);a.cmp(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'fill_continue');a.call('service')
 a.label('fill_continue');a.emit(5,0x4a);a.cond(0xd7,'fill_buffer')
 a.imm(0x44,0xa55a);a.st(0x44,BUFFER-2);a.st(0x44,BUFFER+4096)
 a.clr(0x30);a.clr(0x34);a.clr(0x36);a.clr(0x3e);a.clr(0x58)
 a.imm(0x40,0xffff);a.mov(0x32,0x0a);a.mov(0x38,0x32);a.mov(0x5a,0x32)
 a.byte(0x44,1);a.stb(0x44,CONTROL+18)
 a.call('transaction');a.stb(0,CONTROL+18)
 # Cancellation is an operation result after a successful command drain.
 # Transport failures and original CHECK CONDITION keep precedence.
 a.ld(0x44,CONTROL+16);a.cmp(0x44,0);a.cond(0xdf,'record_result')
 a.cmp(0x3e,0);a.cond(0xd7,'record_result');a.cmpb(0x40,0);a.cond(0xd7,'record_result')
 a.imm(0x3e,7)
 a.label('record_result')
 # Capture results without interpreting status as the transport outcome.
 for reg,offset in [(0x3e,0),(0x30,2),(0x40,4),(0x34,8),(0x36,10),(0x3a,12),(0x32,14),(0x2a,16),(0x5a,18),(0x26,20)]:
  a.emit(0xc3,0x23);a.word(offset);a.emit(reg)
 a.ldb(0x44,0xe40a);a.emit(0xc7,0x23,6,0,0x44)
 for address,offset in [(BUFFER-2,22),(BUFFER+4096,24)]:
  a.ld(0x44,address);a.emit(0xc3,0x23);a.word(offset);a.emit(0x44)
 for address,offset in [(CONTROL+16,26),(CONTROL+20,28),(CONTROL+22,30)]:
  a.ld(0x44,address);a.emit(0xc3,0x23);a.word(offset);a.emit(0x44)
 a.label('case_complete');a.st(0x26,CONTROL+4)
 a.ld(0x44,CONTROL+16);a.cmp(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'finish_operation')
 a.emit(0x65,14,0,0x20,0x65,RECORD_SIZE,0,0x22,7,0x26,5,0x24);a.cond(0xd7,'case_loop')
 a.label('finish_operation');a.ldb(0x44,CONTROL+14);a.stb(0x44,0x115)
 a.imm(0x44,0xb502);a.st(0x44,CONTROL)
 for r in reversed(saved):a.emit(0xcc,r)
 a.label('exit_bank_write');a.emit(0xcf,1,0x0a,1);a.emit(0xf5)
 a.label('original_replay');a.emit(*original[HOOK:HOOK+8]);a.emit(0xf0)

 a.label('transaction')
 a.call('cancel_scan');a.ld(0x44,CONTROL+16);a.cmp(0x44,0);a.cond(0xdf,'acquire_bus')
 a.imm(0x3e,7);a.emit(0xf0)
 a.label('acquire_bus')
 a.ldb(0x44,0xe40a);a.emit(0x71,0x48,0x44);a.cmpb(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'busy')
 a.byte(0x44,255);a.stb(0x44,0xe408)
 a.byte(0x44,1);a.ldb(0x46,0x3623);a.emit(0x19,0x46,0x44,0x90,0x50,0x44);a.stb(0x44,0xe416)
 a.byte(0x44,0x10);a.stb(0x44,0xe418);a.stb(0,0xe41a);a.byte(0x44,4);a.stb(0x44,0xe41c)
 a.stb(0,0xe410);a.byte(0x44,0x24);a.stb(0x44,0xe404);a.byte(0x58,1)
 a.label('selection');a.call('budget');a.cond(0xdb,'cleanup')
 a.ldb(0x44,0xe408);a.emit(0x71,4,0x44);a.cmpb(0x44,0);a.cond(0xd7,'absent')
 a.ldb(0x44,0xe408);a.emit(0x71,0x10,0x44);a.cmpb(0x44,0);a.cond(0xdf,'selection')
 a.label('cdb_loop');a.call('req');a.cond(0xdb,'cleanup')
 a.cmpb(0x43,2);a.cond(0xd7,'phase_error')
 a.emit(0xb2,0x29,0x44);a.stb(0x44,0xe416);a.call('ack');a.cond(0xdb,'cleanup')
 a.emit(5,0x2a);a.cond(0xd7,'cdb_loop')
 a.label('data_loop');a.call('req');a.cond(0xdb,'cleanup')
 a.cmpb(0x43,3);a.cond(0xdf,'status')
 a.cmpb(0x5c,0);a.cond(0xdf,'data_in')
 a.cmpb(0x43,0);a.cond(0xd7,'phase_error')
 a.emit(0x88,0x2e,0x30);a.cond(0xdb,'capacity')
 a.emit(0xb2,0x2d,0x44);a.stb(0x44,0xe416);a.jmp('data_ack')
 a.label('data_in')
 a.cmpb(0x43,1);a.cond(0xd7,'phase_error')

for n,i in pairs(m.devices[':'].items) do
 if n:match('/m_banked_ram$') then ram=emu.item(i) end
 if n:match('/m_bank_regs$') then banks=emu.item(i) end
 if n:match('/m_native_wave$') then wave=emu.item(i) end
end
local function bank(a) return banks:read(a-0x100)|(banks:read(a-0xff)<<8) end
local function dump(name)
 local f=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..name..'.ram','wb'));f:write(ram:read_block(0,ram.count));f:close()
 f=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..name..'.wave','wb'));f:write(wave:read_block(0,16+40*9216));f:close()
end
local log=assert(io.open(folder..'/cursor.jsonl','w'));_G.pair_taps={}
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_write_tap(0x3616,0x3617,'pair-cursor',function(a,d,mask)
 if bank(0x108)==0x204 then log:write(json.stringify({seconds=m.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,data=d,mask=mask})..'\n');log:flush() end
end))
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_write_tap(0x5e00,0x5e01,'pair-result',function(a,d,mask)
 if bank(0x10a)==15 and d>=1 and d<=4 then dump('case-'..d) end
end))
local seen=''
emu.register_periodic(function()
 local f=io.open(folder..'/snapshot-request.txt','r');if not f then return end
 local tag=f:read('*a');f:close();if tag==seen or not tag:match('^[%w_-]+$') then return end;seen=tag;dump(tag)
 f=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.json','w'));f:write('{}');f:close()
end)

local events=assert(io.open(folder..'/service.jsonl','w'))
local function event(name)
 events:write(json.stringify({name=name,seconds=m.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,owner=ram:read(0x5bf0),cursor=ram:read(0x84616)|(ram:read(0x84617)<<8)})..'\n');events:flush()
end

local regs=cpu.spaces['register']
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,regs:install_read_tap(0x16,0x17,'timer-ios',function(a,d,mask) if ram:read(0x5bf0)==1 then event('timer-ios') end end))
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_read_tap(0x116,0x117,'midi-data',function(a,d,mask) if ram:read(0x5bf0)==1 then event('midi-data') end end))

  events:write(json.stringify({name='sds-gate',seconds=m.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,owner=ram:read(0x5bf0),command=ram:read(0xb2848),cursor=ram:read(0x84616)|(ram:read(0x84617)<<8)})..'\n');events:flush()
 end
end))
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_write_tap(0x5ff0,0x5ff1,'owner',function(a,d,mask) if bank(0x10a)==15 then event('owner-write-'..d) end end))

table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_write_tap(0xb048,0xb049,'command-byte',function(a,d,mask)

  events:write(json.stringify({name='command-byte',seconds=m.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,owner=ram:read(0x5bf0),data=d,mask=mask})..'\n');events:flush()
 end
end))
table.insert(_G.pair_taps,p:install_write_tap(0x2bba,0x2bbb,'sds-state',function(a,d,mask)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
